# Pull Request: feature/week-09-react-advanced → main

This PR adds the initial scaffold and core features for Week 09: React Advanced.

What this PR includes:

- Vite + React scaffold and package.json
- Routing (React Router): /, /posts, /posts/:id, /about
- Posts page with CreatePost form (POSTs to JSONPlaceholder) and optimistic update
- Components: Header, PostList, PostCard, PostForm
- Hooks: useFetch, useLocalStorage
- Exercises: UseEffect demo, Custom Hooks demo
- Basic styles with CSS Modules

How to test locally:

- Checkout branch `feature/week-09-react-advanced`
- npm install
- npm run dev

Notes / next steps:

- Replace JSONPlaceholder base URL in src/lib/posts.js with real API if available
- Add more lesson 17/18 exercises and unit tests
- Accessibility review and responsive CSS polish
